period_context_guide.relevant_fact: Planar Delights is listed as a read-only Rain of Fear recipe book, separately from books requiring scribing.

in_universe_book.title: Planar Delights
in_universe_book.relevant_fact: Book explicitly describes mixing Planar Goo with a Water Flask and lists Barbequed/Beer-Battered basic families. Current PEQ book copy is corroboration, not a captured May2013 client/server receipt.

contemporaneous_observation.relevant_fact: Author describes Planar Goo and Planar Energy Shard gathering for then-current crafting. This is general availability evidence, not numeric formula proof for each derivative.

availability_evidence.per_recipe_source: Each source_facts entry binds the exact current RoF category row line span, ingredients, quantities, returns, yield and trivial. All19 have explicit named rows; no recipe formula inferred from a name or adjacent ID.
availability_evidence.historical_limit: No archived pre-May31,2013 capture of each numeric derivative formula has yet been obtained. Source publication can record this; production acceptance must retain the distinction.

restriction_review.skill: Baking60 verified from common/skills.h, not erroneous MCP skill examples.
restriction_review.cap: Ordinary RoF crafting cap is separate from recipe trivial; these recipes include trivials above300 and are not excluded for that reason. No cap rule is modified.
restriction_review.learn: Planar Delights is in the source guide read-only list; no scribing requirement asserted for these19 ordinary recipes. Merchant Alliance/quest-special recipes are outside this batch.
restriction_review.class_race: Source catalogue ordinary foods are all-class/all-race; no racial/class quest container inferred. Existing engine gates preserved.
restriction_review.containers: Current engine interprets bag type tokens and inventory item IDs. Source ordinary mixing bowls/ovens use BagType14/15; no broader custom container or cultural equivalence invented. Basic oven slot capacity is not increased.
restriction_review.utensils: Pot/Smoker/Skewers are consumed as input and returned on both success and failure where source explicitly lists them; no salvage double-return.
